entities.summary: Mame-Marie Sy-Diop is a Senegalese basketball player. In 2009 she was a member of the Senegal team when they won the FIBA Africa Championship for Women that year. She was a member of the Senegal women's national basketball team at the 2016 Summer Olympics.
